parameters.name: DeploymentSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the deployment set.

parameters.name: DeploymentSetName
parameters.description: The new name of the deployment set. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The new description of the deployment set. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-deployment-set-attribute --deployment-set-id ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4p0000 --description TestDescription --deployment-set-name DeploymentSetTestName --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyDeploymentSetAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --DeploymentSetId 'ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4p0000' --Description TestDescription --DeploymentSetName DeploymentSetTestName --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
